mapper.select: SELECT scenario_node_option_no, node_no, next_node_no, label, condition_expr, sort_order, use_yn, frst_reg_dt, lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario_node_option WHERE node_no = #{nodeId} ORDER BY sort_order, scenario_node_option_no

SELECT scenario_node_option_no, node_no, next_node_no, label, condition_expr, sort_order, use_yn, frst_reg_dt, lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario_node_option WHERE node_no = #{nodeId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order, scenario_node_option_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_scenario_node_option (node_no, next_node_no, label, condition_expr, sort_order, use_yn) VALUES (#{nodeNo}, #{nextNodeNo}, #{label}, #{conditionExpr}, #{sortOrder}, #{useYn})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_scenario_node_option WHERE node_no IN (SELECT scenario_node_no FROM tb_scenario_node WHERE version_no = #{versionId})
